name: ultraweb
description: Guided webdesign harness for Next.js: a dynamic scoping interview, a three-candidate mockup round, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints on a real-studio cadence — first-page review on the built homepage, preflight/UAT acceptance before ship, a dial from hands-off to full sign-off (classic one-prompt autonomous mode on request) — 75 interlocking skills with real-world worked examples, model-routed subagents (Opus 5 / Sonnet 5), design taste, an award-canon study library distilled from Awwwards-winning sites, design systems, components, motion — including a DIRECTION-gated anime.js SVG-choreography engine and a DIRECTION-gated site-scale immersive-3D build — Next.js engineering, backend, and quality gates
